title: Latestfile v0.1
description: Schema for the canonical JSON form of a Latestfile: a portable declaration of how a developer, team, or organization uses AI in their development workflow.

toolMap.description: Map from tool name (block label) to tool block. Tool names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

toolBlock.description: A tool block. The reserved fields 'from', 'version', and 'provider' are typed; all other fields are vendor-defined and unconstrained.

modelMap.description: Map from model name (block label) to model block. Model names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

modelBlock.description: A model block. The reserved fields 'from', 'version', and 'provider' are typed; all other fields are vendor-defined and unconstrained.

workflowMap.description: Map from workflow name (block label) to workflow block. Workflow names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

workflowBlock.description: A workflow block. Informational in v0.1; reserved fields are 'description', 'uses', and 'models'.

instructionsMap.description: Map from instructions name (block label) to instructions block. Names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

instructionsBlock.description: An instructions block. Reserved fields are 'source' (relative file path or https URL) and 'applies_to' (array of references).

contextMap.description: Map from context name (block label) to context block. Names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

contextBlock.description: A context block. Reserved fields are 'import' (optional registry URI), 'tools', and 'models'.

profileMap.description: Map from profile name (block label) to profile block. Names MUST match the identifier pattern [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*.

profileBlock.description: A profile block. Reserved fields are 'role' (free-form string) and 'contexts' (array of references).

reference.description: A reference to another block expressed as a string. In the canonical JSON form, HCL reference expressions (e.g., tool.cursor, tool["claude-code"], org.model["gpt4-azure"]) appear as ${...} template strings per the HCL2 JSON specification. Semantic resolution of references is out of scope for this schema.

registryUri.description: A registry URI: registry:[<host>/]<namespace>[/<name>][@<version>]. Hostnames are optional and default to latest.dev. Namespace and name match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*. Version, when present, is a semver-compatible version string.

semverConstraint.description: A semver constraint string. Accepts common forms like '1.0', '1.0.0', '>=1.0', '~> 0.45', '^1.2.3', 'v1.2.3-beta'.
